template.name: template_map_button_indicator
template.event:
local showTribalAlert = (game.numIslands() > 1 or game.playerLevel() >= 10) and (game.newTribalInviteNotice() or game.newTribalRequestNotice()) local showColdIslandAlert = game.playerLevel() >= 6 and not game.isIslandOwned(2) and game.playerCanAffordIsland(2)
if( showTribalAlert or showColdIslandAlert or game.activeEventForCategory(game.StoreCategories_TYPE_ISLAND)) then element:SetVisible() else element:SetInvisible() end

local showTribalAlert = (game.numIslands() > 1 or game.playerLevel() >= 10) and (game.newTribalInviteNotice() or game.newTribalRequestNotice()) local showColdIslandAlert = game.playerLevel() >= 6 and not game.isIslandOwned(2) and game.playerCanAffordIsland(2)
if( showTribalAlert or showColdIslandAlert) then element["TribeIndicator"]:SetVisible() else element["TribeIndicator"]:SetInvisible() end
